prior_year_events.event_name: 2007 Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice / RITC
prior_year_events.impact_description: Liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened prior to RITC; RITC closed the year and transferred assets and liabilities to an external syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported adverse reserve development across prior years, noting that loss experience on all years of account was significantly worse than anticipated and that reserves were strengthened to reflect this. The claims development table shows no net movement on older underwriting years at the aggregate gross level (calculated from the published gross claims development table). The 2007 underwriting year was closed by an external RITC on 15 November 2016 and liabilities for that year were explicitly strengthened by GBP 5.833m prior to closure.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.
The underwriting loss of GBP 151,717k, analysed below, comprises adverse movements on all underwriting years.

Prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k, taking the total due from members and the Lloyd's Central Fund (LCF) to GBP 45,158k, this amount was settled during the financial year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year movement figure (Insurance liabilities column) was located in a single 'movement in prior year' note. The claims development (gross) triangle was used as the primary source and yields no net movement on older underwriting years (calculated result = 0). The 2007 year was subject to an external RITC and explicitly strengthened by GBP 5.833m (gross). Some narrative statements describe adverse movements and strengthening but quote net figures or P&L 'claims incurred' rows which are not valid sources for prior-year reserve movement per instructions. Prior-year movement derived from triangle (gross) - confidence moderate-high.
